knowledge_gaps: Reproduction requires explicit tokenization, vocabulary limits, rare/OOV-token handling, field truncation lengths, token dimensions, optimizer settings, and regularization. Mean pooling preserves tokens but loses word order and compatibility relationships.

Detached identity-norm matching changes gradient flow; epsilon-safe normalization can still produce large gradients near zero. Initialization, mixed-precision stability, and missing-text backward behavior need specification.

No baseline host validation scores, paired comparison plan, or training-cost allocation is supplied. Training-pair errors do not establish a representation problem, and repeated validation selection can overfit 200 users per category.

The embedding replacement must preserve baseline initialization despite additional random draws, include lexical parameters in optimization, and support bounded-memory full-catalog scoring with exact checkpoint/predictor consistency.

Originality 4 is plausible, but potential 7 and difficulty 4 are subjective. Existing pretrained-text evidence does not establish scratch-token effectiveness, and production of lexical assets and compatible diagnostics adds implementation work.

follow_up_queries.reason: Identify reproducible scratch-text baselines and determine whether pooled lexical features capture useful distinctions beyond superficial similarity. Keep the proposed lexical experiment first; defer objective and temporal changes.
follow_up_queries.query: Sequential recommendation jointly trained item ID and title description token embeddings from scratch without pretrained weights: what tokenization, vocabulary size, truncation, pooling, regularization, and controlled ablations are reported? Compare mean pooling with order-sensitive encoders for product model numbers, negation, and compatibility.

follow_up_queries.reason: Resolve numerical and integration risks before spending the training budget; successful forward masking alone does not establish stable gradients or unchanged baseline initialization.
follow_up_queries.query: PyTorch identity plus text residual item embedding using normalized text vectors scaled by detached identity norms: what are the gradient and mixed precision stability implications near zero, safe missing-field masking practices, RNG isolation for baseline initialization, and exact evaluation-time caching requirements?

follow_up_queries.reason: Define a defensible validation comparison and expose popularity or lexical shortcuts without changing the pinned evaluator or using held-out test labels.
follow_up_queries.query: Recommender evaluation with fixed 99 sampled negatives and 200 validation users per dataset: how should paired HR@10 differences and four-dataset macro-average uncertainty be assessed under repeated hyperparameter selection? What text-shuffling, item-frequency, and missing-text analyses distinguish semantic benefit from popularity shortcuts while retaining one trained model per dataset?
